title: Harden creature attack/action parsing and alternate-mode representation
acceptance_criteria:
- Every printed attack in every stat block produces an attack object; the attack inventory is proven complete by a corpus-wide predicate.
- A Unicode minus, an alternate range notation, or a parenthetical alternate bonus cannot silently drop a value — each has a negative regression test.
- Mutually exclusive damage modes are represented as alternatives, never as a flat cumulative array.
- Target qualifiers survive projection in full.
